subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella and sequence Track A through Track D from it?
rationale: Source evidence confirms the problem class, but the proposed fix chooses cross-cutting lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, persistence, and Codex-wrapper behavior across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as direction and keep the issue open while Tracks A-D land as focused PRs with source and live proof.

options.title: Approve only Track A/B now
options.body: Use this issue for abort-to-release and evidence-based liveness first, while deferring durability and completion-drive decisions to separate design review.

options.title: Return to bug-specific reports
options.body: Decline the umbrella and keep each linked production report or PR as the canonical unit of work.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as direction and keep the issue open while Tracks A-D land as focused PRs with source and live proof.
